Normalization: Ordered native SDK/raw calls, all through actual TLS. Synthetic keys are ASCII a/b repeated32 bytes, base64 wire encoded with explicit MD5; Payloads are exact byte recipes. Issued version/upload IDs and opaque customer-encrypted ETags bind dynamically, including nested copy results. Native identical payload/key writes produced distinct non-MD5 ETags: values preserved only in evidence, never fixed in replay. Request IDs, timestamps, archive restore scheduling, AWS-managed KMS ARN and lifecycle expiration clock are not projected. Raw ListParts/Attributes project stable checksum/size fields, not unavailable SDK headers or opaque XML ETags. Native restore initiation is replayed, never inferred archive aging or restore completion. Cleanup independent NoSuchBucket checks remain in compressed evidence.
SDKNormalization: ListParts PartNumberMarker and NextPartNumberMarker use string fields in the Go SDK; native CLI numeric marker values retain the same decimal text.
